audit_phase: Phase 5.14.5.2 — Final Terminal Validation & Stale Approval Safety
component: Atomic Publication & Double Invalidation Safety with Journal Restart Protection (Fix B)

failure_model.description: Double failure during manifest commit: os.replace() fails AND fallback unlinking fails (e.g. permission lock), combined with journal update failure and process restart
failure_model.vulnerability_remediated: Older valid manifest (Generation A) surviving on disk while new attempt (Generation B) fails, or fresh process accepting stale approval
prevention_mechanism: Attempt identity generation prior to file modification (gen_id)
Durable atomic pre-publication attempt recording with fsync synchronization
Immediate publication abort before modifying artifacts if initial journal write fails (Test A)
In-progress attempt tracking preventing stale approval survival across application restart (Test B)
Unverifiable fail-closed behavior on missing, corrupted, or truncated journal (Test C)
Successful clean recovery and cross-artifact generation ID verification (Test D)
Explicit recording of failed_recovery_operations and invalidation_succeeded = False
Authoritative reader checks attempt state before accepting manifest
Fails closed with UNVERIFIABLE state when on-disk manifest belongs to previous generation

mandatory_adversarial_tests.description: Inject failure when recording Generation B's initial IN_PROGRESS journal state. Verifies publication aborts before overwriting Generation A's artifacts and reader cannot mistake incomplete B for successful B.
Fail summary replacement, manifest replacement, manifest unlink, and journal update during recovery. Clear in-memory state. Verifies old Generation A approval is rejected by fresh process.
Corrupt or truncate on-disk journal. Clear in-memory state. Verifies reader returns UNVERIFIABLE and never returns approval.
Following failed attempt, perform clean publication. Verifies new generation is committed and accepted, with generation ID matching across all artifacts.
11-step end-to-end simulation of double invalidation failure with os.replace and unlink errors.
